blocks.text: Corridor Éléphant presents the series by Stefan Wasser titled Three American Military Cemeteries . He writes:
My project “Three American Military Cemeteries” brings together photographs taken at the American military cemeteries of Margraten (Netherlands), Henri-Chapelle and Neupré (Belgium).
For once, I am mostly interested in the people one can meet in these places.

There are many reasons to visit a military cemetery. Many visitors have sponsored a soldier’s grave (notably in the Netherlands). They come to lay flowers on the soldier’s birthday or on major commemorative occasions. Others, aware of the historical context, come to put a name and an image to their theoretical knowledge.
And for others, the cemeteries are a welcome stop during their bike rides (Henri-Chapelle and Margraten), since they are also extremely well-kept public parks.
Like time capsules, these cemeteries assert their presence – and the past they represent – in the midst of an ever-changing world.

Stefan Wasser , of German origin, has lived in Liège since 1994. A musician by profession at the Opéra Royal de Wallonie, he has also made a name for himself as a photographer (published in “Chasseur d’Images”, first prize in the national CEWE competition, numerous exhibitions, notably at the “Moormuseum Emsland”, the Centre Culturel de Seraing, etc.).
